simulations.title: Simulated features
simulations.subtitle: What really works and what is simulated
simulations.intro: Editing, selection, the inspector, fades, the prompt library, the assistant, conflict checks, the 3D scene (camera, trajectories, keyframes) and the console work in the browser. The following are simulated and carry the {badge} badge:
simulations.render3d.title: 3D render modes and engine settings
simulations.render3d.text: AI generation is real. The “3D render” and “3D render + AI” output modes start nothing yet. The settings greyed in the Advanced workshop are not sent to the engine: the seed (each take draws its own), the final resolution (the final uses the largest resolution of the engine), steps, CFG, LoRA, windows, consistency, post-processing and the Hybrid AV audio driver; nor are the Control videos and the Hybrid builder weights. Takes made by earlier versions keep their numbered thumbnail.
simulations.synopsis.title: Synopsis breakdown
simulations.synopsis.text: The Propose a breakdown button only turns each sentence into a shot; the assistant proposes the real breakdown from the whole synopsis.
simulations.identity.title: Identity check
simulations.identity.text: The similarity between takes is simulated. The color check really analyzes the images.
simulations.render.title: Video render
simulations.render.text: No video file is written. The Final Cut, OTIO, EDL and SRT exports produce real files.
simulations.splat.title: Gaussian Splat
simulations.splat.text: The referenced file is not loaded; the sample scene is a generated point cloud.
simulations.guide.title: Control video
simulations.guide.text: Computing the guide from the 3D scene is simulated.
simulations.sound.title: Voice and sound design
simulations.sound.text: Preparation is simulated; the preview is a simple synthesis.
simulations.audio.title: Edit audio
simulations.audio.text: Imported audio files really play; prepared sounds use real-time synthesis (WebAudio). Faders, mute/solo, pan, equalizer, compressor, sends and meters really work.

splat.note: The file is referenced, not copied. Splats are not loaded: the camera and guides stay usable.
